architecture: v3 (architecture 3, re-root 2026-11-02: a new world, dataset and shell, after architecture 2's SEND_BACK)
slot_note: Re-rooted at stage 1 a second time: architecture 1 (the FC25 seed's economics world, a bank desk's advance GDP call) and architecture 2 (a Kansas gas transmission dig plan, energy systems and utilities) are spent, lineage below. Architecture 3 keeps nothing of either world: an English spring water bottler applies to renew and raise its groundwater abstraction licence for a new bottling line, and the decisive step is re-found in how a confined aquifer cut by a fault responds over a licence term to a borehole that a three-day test saw only as an unbounded aquifer.
niche: a spring water bottler's licence renewal and variation for a new bottling line: the largest daily groundwater abstraction from its confined sandstone borehole whose predicted drawdown at each neighbouring licensed borehole stays within that borehole's available drawdown at the 2039 common end date, under the licensing team's derogation test
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the pre-application letter's derogation test correctly, fits the field's Theis solution to the 2014 constant-rate test (a clean fit at every observation borehole) and superposes the existing and applied quantities to 31 March 2039 files about 2,300 cubic metres a day as the largest quantity, with Kilnbrook Nurseries limiting it and 1,800 passing; the golden, in which the Coldharbour Fault closes the aquifer to the east so every protected borehole also feels Borehole 2's image across it, files 1,300 with Lower Hay Farm limiting and 1,800 failing there.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the drawdown a groundwater abstraction causes at neighbouring licensed boreholes over a licence term, the hydrologist's forecast behind every licence variation, and it turns on the aquifer's geometry and the physics of radial flow to a well (a confined sandstone the fault juxtaposes against mudstone, so the cone that reaches the fault deepens on the near side as if a second well pumped beyond it); with a hospital's or a retailer's nouns there is no aquifer, no cone of depression and nothing for a barrier to reflect, so the task stops reading.
layer2_pattern: own:aquifer barrier felt only over the licence horizon, not in the pumping test
layer1: the 2014 constant-rate test's loggers in two makes (pressure in kPa against water level in metres above the sensor), each borehole's dip datum its own casing top, logger clocks on GMT against the field sheets' local time
the observation boreholes' monthly dips since 2015 as depth below casing top, a casing raised on one borehole in 2020 and resurveyed
the regional observation borehole's daily levels in metres above ordnance datum, gaps at logger swaps
borehole coordinates as national grid references in the survey and as eastings and northings in the logs
the borehole logs in drillers' lithology words against the geological map's formation names
abstraction telemetry every 15 minutes in UTC with a totaliser that rolls over, the site engineer's weekly meter readings and the annual returns in licence years April to March
bottling line production in the plant system's runs and pack sizes, line water sub-meters, bulk tanker sales on the haulier's tickets
stakeholder_role: the bottler's water resources lead who prepares its licence renewal and variation for the licensing team

spine.entity: one logger reading in the June 2014 constant-rate test and its recovery (the pumping borehole and three observation boreholes)

world.geography: England, the West Midlands (a fictional spring water bottler and village in a real county setting)
world.org_type: a spring water bottler with its own licensed borehole

driver: A response measured over a short disturbance in what behaves as an unbounded medium is carried over a horizon hundreds of times longer, but the medium is closed on one side by a barrier the short test never reached; over the long horizon every point also carries the response of a mirror source beyond the barrier, close to doubling it nearest the barrier and moving which constraint binds, and only the barrier's mapped trace, a record from across it that stays flat where the unbounded model expects a response, and the long record's own excess show it.
driver_concrete: Borehole 2's 2014 constant-rate test fits Theis cleanly at every observation borehole because in 72 hours its cone never reached the Coldharbour Fault two kilometres east, which throws the Sherwood Sandstone against Mercia Mudstone; over the derogation test's 24 years the cone is held by the fault, so each protected borehole's drawdown is Borehole 2's own plus that of its image across the fault (Lower Hay Farm, half a kilometre from the fault, nearly double), which the observation boreholes' dips since 2015 (deeper than the test's Theis predicts) and the regional borehole beyond the fault (no response at all) bear out.
stump: Projecting the field's Theis solution fitted to the 2014 constant-rate test over the derogation test's 24 years files about 2,300 cubic metres a day as the largest quantity, Kilnbrook Nurseries limiting it and the new line's 1,800 passing everywhere, because the 72-hour test never reached the Coldharbour Fault: over the licence term the fault closes the aquifer to the east, every protected borehole carries Borehole 2's image across it as well, and Lower Hay Farm's drawdown at 1,800 is about 10.5 metres against its 7.8, so the largest quantity that passes is 1,300.

differentiation.task174: task174 v2 recovers each member's within-session gain from stopping records broken by overnight breaks; here nothing is learned or forgotten: an aquifer's response to one borehole, fitted cleanly on a three-day test, is carried over 24 years in which a fault the test never reached holds and deepens the cone
differentiation.task178: task178's harbour trestle deck (architecture 1) builds a period's crossings from a deterministic component already known for that period; here no component is known ahead: the long-horizon response gains a mirror source across a barrier that only the map, a record beyond it and the long record's own excess show
differentiation.task461: task461 extends a short target record through a correlated long auxiliary record's proportional relation; here no record is extended by a correlate: the model fitted to the short test is replaced over the horizon by one closed at the fault, and the long record serves only to refute the unbounded model
differentiation.task229: task229 v2 corrects a checked-unit rate for checks that see units just before resetting them, and v3 a convex conversion of a cycled input; here nothing is checked, reset or converted: a cone of depression reaches a barrier only after the test that measured the aquifer had ended
differentiation.task242: task242 corrects a detector whose chance of registering an event fades with the time since it happened; here nothing is detected or fades: the response grows over the horizon as a mirror source beyond a barrier adds to it
differentiation.task476: task476 v2 dates each leak's unrecorded start within its inspection interval from a seasonal start profile; here no start is dated: the moment the cone meets the barrier follows from the aquifer's own diffusivity and the fault's distance, and it falls after the test and inside the licence term
differentiation.task501: task501 v4 reads a who-passes-to-whom matrix's eigenvalue under one season's contact regime rather than pooled days; here no matrix or regime is pooled: a short test's unbounded fit is carried over a long horizon in which a barrier nearly doubles the response near it

lineage.architecture: v1 (architecture 1, the FC25 seed's economics world: a bank research desk's call on the advance real GDP estimate)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at the re-root: the honest strategy decomposition_attribution BLOCKed (ban.strategy) against task234 v2, the stage 3 relabel to time_semantics reverted as a card written to pass, and the rule 3 audit AT_RISK (the holding period read off a column of Table 7; P(both landed) about 0.10)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the change over a period in the volume of a stock that each holder reports at what it paid, and because a holder's stock on any date was bought over a holding period of its own, the reported value mixes the prices of the weeks the goods were bought in; read at the reporting month's price, the textbook removal of price gains, a price step inside the holding period reads as a fall in volume, read at the period's average price it reads the other way, and only revaluing each holder's stock at the average price over its own holding period, at both ends of the period, separates volume from price.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each industry's end-March and end-June book-value stocks (wholesale, retail and manufacturing, from the trade and business stocks bulletin) are revalued at the average of the industry's input price index over the months its stock-to-sales ratio covers before the change in inventory volume is taken, because import prices rose in March and again in June and the stock on hand at each quarter end was partly bought before each rise; deflating at the quarter end's own price index understates the volume at both quarter ends, the June one by more because the larger leg sits inside its holding period, so the quarter reads as a deeper run-down (2.2 against 2.8), and deflating at the quarter's average price reads it the other way (3.3).
lineage.stump: A strong analyst who takes the desk's track for every line the late bulletin does not feed, builds goods exports and imports from the bulletin section by section and deflates each industry's end-March and end-June book-value stocks by that month's price index, the textbook removal of holding gains, files 2.2 per cent against the golden 2.8, because the June leg of the import price rise reads as a fall in the volume of stocks that were bought before it.

lineage.architecture: v2 (architecture 2, a Kansas gas transmission operator's 2027-2031 dig plan for its 1974 Northline)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at stage 4: the single re-judge after the field-check FIX_NOW (cut 2320312b, determinism_check_report_pass2.md) returned NOT_DETERMINISTIC, SEND_BACK, underspecified_objective on the main call; every golden figure reproduced, but no shipped file forced the growth-rate basis: the never-failed zones carried old external metal loss up to 29 per cent, so a rate with that background taken off first was as defensible and moved the count from 34 to 29, 24 or 17 and could flip the call; filing the basis would have filed the method, and a rate read from one inspection leaves the method space open
lineage.driver: A size that grows only while a protecting condition fails, read once, is its rate times the time the condition has failed at it, and that time runs from the moment a second record shows the condition first failing, not from the unit's installation; spreading the size over the unit's whole age slows every growing unit severalfold, so the forward count of units that reach a limit inside the window is a small fraction of the count their growth since the failure gives, and the units that once failed and were restored do not grow at all.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each external corrosion pit on the Northline grew only while its rectifier zone was below the protection criterion, which the rectifiers' daily monitoring readings and the technicians' inspections date zone by zone, so its growth rate is its May 2025 depth over the days since its zone's rectifier output fell, running on until the capital plan's project restores the zone and never in the zones at criterion at the run.
lineage.stump: Growing each external anomaly at its full-life rate, its May 2025 depth over the years since the Northline went into service in October 1974, files the 24 funded digs as enough with 0 needed in any plan year, because each pit in a rectifier zone still below the protection criterion grew only since that zone's rectifier output fell (R-5 on 9 July 2016, R-7 on 12 August 2019) and keeps that pace until the capital plan restores the zone, so the plan needs 4, 9, 11, 6 and 4 digs, 34 in all.

notes: Strategy forecast_method_backtest, the honest label: the natural fit (Theis on the 72-hour test) is right in sample and wrong over the decision's horizon, and the honest history that refutes it is the observation boreholes' own dips since 2015 and the regional borehole beyond the fault; no back-test is filed and no organ is built for it. Gate G method_or_model_selection: two defensible aquifer models (unbounded and closed by the fault), the right one pinned by the long record and the geology, never by a filed sentence. G13 first (the horizon mismatch between a three-day test and a 24-year assessment), G16 second. Calibration physical_verification: the monthly dips at the observation boreholes and the regulator's daily levels beyond the fault. Context artifact filed_standard: the licensing team's pre-application letter files the derogation test's WHAT (the protected boreholes and their available drawdowns, the rest levels of April 2015, the end date, the quantities and their dates) and names no aquifer model.
